name: Witzi Episode Posters
overview: Persistent 2:3 episode posters generated from each video
description: Extracts representative frames with Jellyfin's configured media encoder, arranges them into a Witzi-styled portrait poster, stores the JPEG beside the episode video, and registers it as the episode Primary image.

versions.changelog: Initialize Jellyfin plugin metadata correctly and prefer hardware-accelerated FFmpeg frame decoding with an automatic software fallback.
Remove the direct SkiaSharp dependency and expose poster generation as a manual-only Library scheduled task.
